programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The house robots venture into the funeral business as they hold cremations and burials in the Robot Wars arena, to the applause of a live audience. One flip may spell doom early on for one competitor.

programme.title: Robot Wars

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One competitor gets chopped up by competitor and house robot alike and a quick eviction from the arena makes the judge’s job a simple one. A seemingly one-sided fight takes a different direction, thanks to the hazardous arena.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: When the competitor’s weapons aren’t quite doing the job, they must resort to using the arena to secure the win. There’s not enough room for the both of them, which robot from the Isle of Sheppey will prove itself the best in this chance encounter.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: World Champions meet a newcomer in this episode’s heat, will it be an easy appetiser, or a major upset? One uneventful round leaves the house robots responsible for entertaining the crowd.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Shunt and Dead Metal prepare to be let loose from the sidelines in this episodes Main Event, House Robot Rebellion. Three unfortunate competitors will be put into the arena as the House Robots have free reign in this destructive episode.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: We have reached the Quarter Finals for the All-Stars battles in this episode’s Main Event and another Mayhem battle puts another three robots up against each other.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Four of the best robots armed with rear-hinged flippers go against each other to prove whose best in Flipper Frenzy. Other battles on the card are the Challenge Belt, Tag Team Terror, Wild Card Warriors and Mayhem battle.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Current World Champions Razer are matched against fierce competitor Firestorm in this All-stars match. Four robots make their way to the arena to take part in the German Melee, with the winner securing a place in the Second World Championship.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Featherweight Championship takes place in this episode, along with the Challenge Belt, Mayhem battle and more Wildcard Warriors. All these build-up to the Main event, the Tag Team Terror finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The second annihilator was supposed to be between the six winners of the mayhem qualifiers, but due to the severity of damage from the battle, two of the robots had to be replaced. Will the two replacements seize this opportunity?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The UK are up against renowned German Engineering in a UK vs Germany battle. Two more rivals have a chance to settle the score in another vengeance battle and other unmissable battles take place before the long awaited All-Stars Grand Final.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Six teams comprised of armed and emergency services enter their robots for battle, will their unpredictable and dangerous occupations prepare them for the carnage of the arena or will the house robots make them quake in their boots?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Robots from around the globe ready themselves for the ultimate contest, The Second World Championship. Will lightning strike twice for defending champions Razer, or will they reign be snuffed out by one of the many fierce competitors?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Six robots come to the arena to try and best the challenges that await, including Skittles, where they must act as an autonomous bowling ball to knock over as many barrels as they can, whilst trying to avoid the house robots.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Competitors have a chance to go head-to-head with a house robot in a test of strength and strategy in this week’s trial, tug of war. Winners progress to the next round, losers take a face first dive into the pit.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This week’s trial takes the competitors back in time to medieval England, where they will joust against an unyielding house robot in hopes of winning a chance at the crown. The house robots team up to take down an unlucky competitor in the arena.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Football returns to the arena in this week’s trial, complete with ferocious tackles, flamethrowers and own goals. In the semi-final, three of the house robots turn the arena into a barbeque.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Competitors need to hold their own in King of the Castle, where they must defend a circle in the arena against the unforgiving house robots. How many will survive to make it to the semi-finals? A winner is decided by the pit in this week’s final.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: House robot, Shunt goes head-to-head with the competitors. It’s his job to remove the competitors from the ring by any means necessary in this week’s trial, Sumo. Will Shunt do the house robots proud, or will the competitors give him the slip?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The gauntlet has a menacing addition, The Sentinel. Will the new robot prove to be a real obstacle, or an easy route to be exploited? The Skittles trial returns to the arena, but one competitor wants to take down more than just barrels.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Football returns this week in the trial. New competitors enter the arena with high hopes of securing a place in the finals. The house robots show no mercy in the Gauntlet.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Matilda’s tusks get put to good use against the competitors as jousting returns to the arena. Two competitors form a rivalry after a memorable battle in the semi-finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Matilda takes centre stage again, as she attempts to pull as many competitors into the pit as possible in another tug of war. How will the competitors fair against the hazards of the arena and the merciless house robots?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Competitors are once again tasked with defending their land in King of the Castle, will they defend their reign or be overthrown by the house robots? An even match in the semi-finals causes the house robots to forcefully decide a winner.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Dead Metal takes to the ring to stop any competitors from progressing to the stage of the competition.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: First of the two Semi-Finals to determine which two of the six heat winners will progress to The Second Wars Grand Finals. The house robots are showing no mercy in the gauntlet and the competitors test their accuracy in this week’s trial, Pinball.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The last Semi-Final, competitors will once again battle the house robots in Pinball, evade them in the gauntlet and use them to destroy other competitors in the arena.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Grand Final arrives, only the best robots have made it this far. The four remaining robots face two eliminators and a playoff. The two winners then face each other to determine who will be named champion of Robot Wars: The Second wars.
